decisions.reason: Although an accelerator program is less core to a German machinery maker than physical plant offerings, the firm has kept it on the home page across 2023 and 2024 and can justify weaker payoffs as part of its broader circular-innovation strategy, which favors continuing rather than admitting a misstep.

Because the bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder was launched as a flagship, builds on the established offer, and still has its own page in 2024, management is likely to stay committed after making a visible strategic and reputational investment in it.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core business, was highlighted on the home page in both years with strong launch claims, and as a stated focus product it is the kind of publicly backed initiative that escalation of commitment makes especially hard to withdraw.
